values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/joneslake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Jones Lake State Forest Campground, Crawford: 42 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch on Jones Lake, with a small picnic area beside it.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/joneslake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'There is a small picnic area near the boat launch.'; amenity table: 'Boat ramp(R) OR carry-in access(C)' R), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/joneslake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table (Jones Lake State Forest Campground: 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 42 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/joneslake ('There are 42 sites for tent and small trailer use.'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (42 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic AuSable State Forest campground on the shore of Jones Lake, 9 mi E of Frederic via County Road 612 and Jones Lake Road (Crawford County); sites across six loops; managed by Hartwick Pines State Park. Fishing, paddling and wildlife watching. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 42 tent/small-trailer sites (confirmed), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Season (open all year, roads not plowed) already manual and matches. Boat launch + picnic area. Not equestrian. Note trimmed of field restatements.
